# SB-1005 Safety bulletin: pinch points during die change

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-CN02

Hazard description
Pinch points are present during die change operations on the machining and workholding assemblies of the turning center. Common pinch locations include the die clamp interface, carriage-to-saddle gap, and manual handling interfaces when aligning dies. Unexpected movement during die change can trap fingers or hands between mating components, leading to crush injuries. Contributing factors observed in recent near-miss reports include incomplete isolation of drive systems, unsecured tooling, and reliance on manual contact to guide heavy die sections into position.

Affected equipment
Primary: EQ-P3-L3-CN02 (Machining CNC turning center #2). The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is 70 hours. Secondary: associated die carts, hoists, and fixtures used during die change activities on line P3-L3.

Required controls
- Lockout/Tagout: Follow MM-P3-L3-CN02 for mechanical and electrical isolation before any die change activity. Ensure personal locks and verification of zero energy state prior to contact with pinch-point areas.
- Standard work: Adhere to SOP-P3-L3-01 and SOP-P3-L3-02 for stepwise die change procedures, including use of alignment tools and sequence verification. Do not bypass interlocks or sensors during procedure.
- Tooling and handling: Use approved lifting fixtures and avoid manual guiding of die edges; maintain minimum two-person lift practices when fixtures are unavailable. Keep hands clear of the die clamp interface and carriage gaps while lowering components.
- Housekeeping and maintenance: Verify way lube service is performed per schedule to maintain predictable axis motion; log service actions on the equipment history record. Inspect guards and removable covers for fastener integrity before reassembly.
- Training: Require refresher training for all personnel performing die changes on EQ-P3-L3-CN02, emphasizing hazard recognition and procedure adherence. Document competencies in the training log.

Effective date
Effective immediately. Related documents: MM-P3-L3-CN02, SOP-P3-L3-01, SOP-P3-L3-02.
